1 Every export runs as a job (one path for GUI and API). A small export is ready within a second, so the dialog goes straight to Ready, as today. The measuring rule shows progress.
2 Files are kept 7 days in the organisation's file storage (as uploads), then deleted by a daily job. Downloads need the export roles (owner, admin, editor, analyst) and are audited.
3 A failed try is retried like any job (5 tries, growing pauses). After the last one the dialog says so with the trace reference; Try again starts a new export.
4 Recent exports lists this survey's exports of the last 7 days, newest first, by person or API key; anyone who may export sees all of them.
5 A notice in the Results header when an export the person started becomes ready while the dialog is closed; it stays until downloaded or dismissed.
6 Settings → API is one screen in the organisation menu (owners and admins), like Domains. Keys belong to the organisation; who created a key is in the audit log.
7 Two presets, details under More: Read results (default) and Full access; expiry 90 days by default (30 days, 1 year, never). No key can manage users, roles or settings.
8 The key is shown once and stored only as a hash; its first 8 characters stay visible to tell keys apart. Exports, downloads and changes through a key are audited with the key as actor.
Email and PDF: not affected; export files are data files, not themed documents.
Open for Dražan: (a) keep export files 7 days (recommended) or 30; (b) every export as a job, also small ones (recommended); (c) presets Read results / Full access (recommended).
